name: waste2watt-ai
description: Turning Waste Intelligence into Energy Decisions.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/shared && npm run dev --workspace @waste2watt/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/shared && npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/api && npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/infra && npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/shared && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @waste2watt/shared && npm run test:ts && npm run test:python && npm run test --workspace @waste2watt/infra && npm run test --workspace @waste2watt/web
scripts.test:python: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests/python -v && ruff check services/analysis services/agent/src ml/src ml/scripts tests/python && ruff format --check services/analysis services/agent/src ml/src ml/scripts tests/python
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
